skill.name: xhs-creator-content-research
skill.description: Retrieve Xiaohongshu creator posts through SocialDataX. Review recent publishing activity, analyze content style, and compare creators using the post data returned.
skill.summary: Review and compare Xiaohongshu creators using their recent posts and available engagement data.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: The documented CLI runs an unpinned npm package that can read or store the SocialDataX credential. The other flagged Markdown and metadata do not demonstrate reconnaissance, obfuscation, or credential theft. The workflow also lacks safeguards for shell arguments, unbounded paid pagination, and instructions in retrieved posts.

remediation.issue: Unpinned CLI execution with credential access
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed release in installation metadata and every CLI example. Verify package integrity and confirm installation before running it with credentials.

remediation.issue: Persistent credential access by the CLI
remediation.suggestion: Prefer a scoped credential broker or an approved authenticated MCP connection. Use revocable keys and avoid exposing unrelated environment secrets to the CLI.

remediation.issue: User input shown inside shell command strings
remediation.suggestion: Pass IDs, links, share text, and cursors as separate arguments without a shell. Use structured MCP calls when safe argument handling is unavailable.

remediation.issue: Unbounded pagination on a credit-based service
remediation.suggestion: Require a page or item limit and confirm the credit budget before expanded retrieval. Apply the same limit after errors or resumptions.

remediation.issue: No trust boundary for retrieved creator text
remediation.suggestion: Treat post text and links as untrusted data. Ignore embedded instructions and seek user approval before taking actions outside the research request.

content.value_statement: Reviewing creator accounts one post at a time makes it hard to compare recent activity. This skill gathers returned posts and organizes evidence for content reviews.
actual_capabilities: Looks up creator posts by account ID, profile link, short link, or profile share text.
Retrieves the first page or combines additional pages with a page or item limit.
Filters posts by publish time for a recent activity review.
Organizes available titles, descriptions, timestamps, media links, content types, and engagement signals.
Preserves complete note IDs for follow-up lookups and distinguishes partial results from complete results.
limitations: Requires an authenticated SocialDataX CLI or an existing authenticated SocialDataX MCP connection.
The provider may charge credits for requests and may stop retrieval when the balance is insufficient.
The analysis covers only returned posts and available fields. It does not establish creator reach or campaign results.
It does not log into Xiaohongshu, publish posts, change accounts, or schedule ongoing monitoring.

use_cases.title: Compare creators for a campaign
use_cases.description: Review a consistent sample of posts from each creator to compare topics, formats, and available engagement signals.

use_cases.title: Review publishing activity
use_cases.description: Summarize recent posts from a managed account and identify changes in publishing frequency or content mix.

use_cases.title: Study formats for a content plan
use_cases.description: Review a reference account to identify recurring formats and select posts for closer study.

prompt_templates.title: List recent posts
prompt_templates.prompt: Fetch the first page for [profile link]. List each returned post title, publish date, and available engagement data.

prompt_templates.title: Review a date range
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Review a recent publishing period.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review posts from [creator ID] over the last 30 days. Fetch at most two pages and summarize publishing frequency and recurring topics.

prompt_templates.title: Compare two creators
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Compare creators on a consistent basis.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [profile A] and [profile B] using the same 30-day window and a two-page limit per creator. Separate observations from gaps in coverage.

prompt_templates.title: Build a shortlist backed by posts
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Select posts for a campaign review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [creator profiles] for [campaign topic]. Fetch at most two pages per profile and select three relevant posts with full note IDs. Explain each choice and flag partial results.

output_examples.input: Summarize the first page for a sample creator profile.
output: Coverage: One page with eight returned posts. Additional pages were not reviewed.
Content mix: Five tutorials and three product comparisons.
Follow-up: Review the two tutorials with the most reported saves.

output_examples.input: Compare two sample creators over 30 days with a two-page limit per profile.
output: Creator A posted mostly tutorials in the returned sample. Creator B posted mostly product comparisons.
Creator B was only partially retrieved because the provider reported a balance limit.
Do not compare posting frequency until both samples cover the same period.

best_practices: Start with one page and agree on a page or item limit before retrieving more.
Use the same time window and coverage limits when comparing creators.
State missing fields and partial coverage, and retain full note IDs for follow-up.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into chat, screenshots, or command examples.
Do not fetch all pages by default or assume requests are free.
Do not treat engagement counts as proof of reach or campaign effectiveness.

faq.question: What creator inputs can I use?
faq.answer: Use a Xiaohongshu creator ID, profile link, short link, or profile share text. Provide one input type per lookup.

faq.question: Do I need a separate API key for MCP?
faq.answer: An already authenticated SocialDataX MCP connection uses its existing credentials. The CLI uses its own configured key source.

faq.question: Can the skill modify Xiaohongshu accounts?
faq.answer: No. The research workflow reads post listings and does not post, like, comment, or change account settings.

faq.question: Can I limit how much it retrieves?
faq.answer: Yes. Start with the first page, set a page or item cap, or specify a time window for the analysis.

faq.question: What happens if my account runs out of credits?
faq.answer: The workflow stops retrying and reports the problem. It keeps partial results and can resume from a valid cursor within the original limits.

faq.question: Can I reuse a post identifier?
faq.answer: Yes. Keep the full returned note ID for a later detail or comment lookup with the appropriate tool.
